Signs of the World

About

I’ve always been envious of those who are bilingual. The ability to speak another language feels like a superpower. The Star Trek universal translator always feels like the ultimate tool, after the replicator of course.

How do you communicate ideas across languages and borders? Our modern solution is to blend iconography and color. Signage leverages graphic design, language, and art to create something functional, and more often than not, beautiful.

Signs of the World is a collection of signs and symbols that represent our best efforts at a universal language. It’s a love letter to designers of all disciplines working each day to tackle problems on a global scale.
